mechanic: green leaf platforms and traversal uses
static_findings: 0x8005BFBC calls player_sector_lookup at 0x80038E48, walks the plant pool, requires extra_state bit 0x04, and dispatches by type.
Green types 1, 4, 9, and 10 route through 0x8005CCE8, which is only the walker continuation; the common animation, reaction, and render loop continues at 0x8005CD2C.
The growth-contact gate requires slot state 0, animation accumulator 0x00030000, extra_state bit 0x04, and quantized squared 3D distance below 900.
Type 4 writes player VY=-3584 at 0x8005D01C. Green types 1, 9, and 10 use the generic radial reaction with VY=-2048 and horizontal push. The type 3/5 VY=-3328 branch is not a green-tier law.

Mature leaf support is supplied through ordinary sector/collision and player Y-commit paths. Per-tier surface heights are model/collision-asset data rather than constants in a separate resident green handler.
The lifecycle loop advances the animation accumulator by 0x8000, manages slot+0x26 and extra-state bits, and can release the slot at an animation terminator.
correction: The earlier shorthand that all green behavior is passive and has no special VY writer is too broad. Mature support is passive collision, but the common growth-reaction loop contains explicit green-type VY writes.
closure_role: Static ASM closes selection, dispatch, reaction, lifecycle, and mature-collision ownership. Runtime evidence remains necessary only for asset-defined surface reachability and hold behavior.
